thread.title: Best Western named one of the most innovative companies by Fast Company

author: Brandon Brown
title: Best Western named one of the most innovative companies by Fast Company
text: 20, 2018, 11:24pm MST Best Western International, Inc. was listed as one of the most innovative companies for its use of augmented reality/virtual reality by business news magazine and website Fast Company . The Phoenix-based hotel brand came in at No. 6 on the publication’s list of most innovated AR/VR companies for the virtual reality tool it developed that lets potential guests visualize hotel locations’ pools, lobbies, fitness centers, parking lots and rooms. This was part of Best Western’s a $2 billion brand refresh . The company partnered with Google to collect 1.7 million photos of its 2,200 North American locations, and then utilized Street View technology to craft an engaging marketing experience. “We are honored to receive this prestigious, highly sought-after recognition from Fast Company ,” David Kong , president and CEO of Best Western, said in statement. “As a brand, Best Western is committed to using the latest technology to meet the needs of today’s travelers, and I am pleased that our virtual reality programs have set a new standard in customer care and the industry at large. We look forward to continuing our position as a frontrunner in innovation and a leader in hospitality.” Best Western also uses VR to train its employees to improve customer relations. Fast Company ranks the top 10 innovative companies in 36 different categories. It then compiles the 50 Most innovated Companies . This year’s top company on the list is Apple Inc. (NASDAQ: AAPL), followed up by Netflix, Inc. (NASDAQ: NFLX) and Square Inc (NYSE: SQ).
